subject: Evaluation acceptance gates, success hotline, and mitigation playbook
messages:
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@stratalogic.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 16:00:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: success gates & next steps (StrataLogic POC)

Hi Anna — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we have a single source of truth for the trial acceptance criteria and ownership: 

1) Success gates (what StrataLogic will verify during the 3-week POC):
   - Latency: 95th percentile <= 280ms for conversational flows (inputs up to 512 tokens) under test harness load (see test plan link).
   - Cost: projected per-API-call token cost within the baseline Redwood quote (+/- 10%).
   - Accuracy: precision on intent extraction >= 92% on your 120-item test set (we can run the seeded test suite week 1).
   - Security: inbound-only VPC peering and audit log delivery to your SIEM (we will enable audit export, see security checklist).

2) POC scope and timeline
   - Week 0 (this week): quick access + sample dataset load.
   - Week 1: integration + seed evaluation run; surface top blockers.
   - Week 2: tuning iteration (quantization/batching recommendations) and second evaluation run.
   - Week 3: acceptance run and handoff conversation.

3) Owners
   - Redwood integration lead: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.com) — onboarding, infra config, acceptance runs.
   - Redwood ops & hotfixs: Avery Johnson (avery.johnson@redwood.com) — blocker triage and escalation.
   - StrataLogic POC owner: Anna Lopez (anna@stratalogic.com) — test data, acceptance sign-off.

4) Blocker protocol (summary)
   - Critical (production-stopping): immediate escalation to our on-call and StrataLogic exec sponsor; workaround or rollback plan within 4 business hours.
   - Major (significant degradation): 24-hour target for mitigation or documented workaround.
   - Minor: tracked in the blocker spreadsheet and prioritized in the weekly sync.

Attached: mutual success plan + initial blocker checklist. Please confirm the acceptance gates or flag any edits by EOD Thursday so we can lock the test harness.

Thanks,
Elliot
Elliot Price
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
-----
Attachment: 2027-05-25_StrataLogic_MutualSuccessPlan.pdf (pdf, 210KB)

From: Anna Lopez <anna@stratalogic.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: success gates & next steps (StrataLogic POC)

Elliot — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Latency: 280ms P95 is fine, but can we include an alternate gate for 99th percentile (target <= 600ms) if the test harness includes tail-heavy conversational flows?
- Accuracy: we'll provide the 120-item set; we also want to run a secondary 500-sample random holdout to validate generalization — will that fit in the scope?
- Security: procurement will need the audit log retention duration (we typically ask for 13 months). Can you confirm audit export frequency and retention defaults?

Assuming you can accommodate the above, we'll lock the timeline. I'll introduce our procurement contact (procurement@stratalogic.com) when we reach SOW stage.

Anna
Anna Lopez
Head of AI Product, StrataLogic

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: prepping test harness & risk items for StrataLogic POC

Elliot / Avery — quickly capturing internal action items after Anna's reply:

- ACTION (Marissa): schedule infra prep for Friday 05/28 — VPC peering, audit export config (confirm retention 13 months) and seed dataset upload. Deliverable: infra checklist + screenshots by EOD Friday.
- ACTION (Avery): draft mitigation ladder for expected blockers and confirm on-call escalation chain. I started the spreadsheet and attached a working version.
- QUESTION (Elliot): do we accept Anna's ask for an additional 500-sample holdout? I think yes but need to confirm resource/time impact to the acceptance run.

Notes on mitigation ladder (first cut):
- Critical: code-level crash or KV-cache corruption. Immediate pager, assign SE, and enable fallback model variant. Recovery target: 4 hours.
- Major: sustained latency > target due to batching mismatch — apply routing policy to smaller batch sizes; recovery target: 24 hours.
- Minor: transient model quality drift — capture prompt set and schedule retrain/tuning in next sprint.

Attachment: poc-blocker-mitigation-checklist.xlsx (workbook)

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Onboarding & Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna@stratalogic.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, procurement@stratalogic.com
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: success gates & next steps (StrataLogic POC) — hotline & escalation path

Anna — quick follow-up to confirm we accept the two asks (99th percentile gate and the 500-sample holdout) and to share our escalation hotline and SOW staging steps: 

- Acceptance updates: add P99 <= 600ms as secondary latency gate; include the 500-sample holdout run in Week 3 acceptance.

- Audit logs: export frequency: hourly; default retention: 13 months (we will provide JSON-delivered export to your S3).

- Escalation & hotline (activated for the POC):
   1) POC hotline (bypass queues): poc-hotline@redwood.com (mon-fri 06:00-18:00 PT) — monitored by Avery and on-call SE.
   2) Critical pager (24/7): +1 (555) 210-9987 (for production-stopping incidents only).
   3) Exec notify: escalate to Elliot + StrataLogic exec sponsor if critical unresolved after 4 hours.

- Next steps on SOW & procurement: once procurement is looped we will send a short SOW with trial terms and a DocuSign link for signature. I put the HubSpot deal on standby until we receive the signed SOW.

Please reply with a confirmation phrase ("accept gates and hotline") to lock the timeline; we'll begin infra prep Friday afternoon.

Thanks — looking forward to this one.
Elliot
Elliot Price
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: poc-blocker-mitigation-checklist.xlsx
